* Acceptance

- The C++, CMake, doc and oresmd templates emit the same marker the SQL templates already emit, naming the template.
- The marker is emitted as output text, not as a mustache comment, which is stripped at render.
- Regenerating every component in the drift registry is byte-identical apart from the added marker lines.
- A check rejects a template whose output carries no marker, so the gap cannot reopen.
